title: As Slow As Possible (±8.64e15 ms)
summary: John Cage's ORGAN²/ASLSP stretched across the full ECMAScript time range, from 271,822 BC to an 'Invalid Date' in 275,760 AD, already about half performed, the same chord sounding in every browser at once.
mechanism: Date.now() placed within the ECMAScript time value range (±8.64e15 ms) selects one of 131,072 hash-determined chords, voiced on demand with Web Audio; the system clock is the only conductor, and new Date(8.64e15+1) computed live is the finale.
references: John Cage, ORGAN²/ASLSP (As SLow aS Possible), 1987
ECMAScript specification, Time Values and Time Range (±8.64e15 ms)
